_purpose: Composer-level overlap between dge/data/dasa_sahitya (web-crawled, 34 composer files, 1396 padas) and dge/data/dasa_sahitya_local/dasa1 (this Android-app asset, 135 dasaru, 13540 keerthanas). This is a first automated + hand-checked pass — nothing here has been merged, everything is 'pending' until a human confirms it. See ../../../../ARCHITECTURE.md for the merge plan.
method: Kannada dasaru name -> IAST transliteration -> fuzzy skeleton match against the 34 web composer display names, then hand-checked against the actual samples (automated fuzzy matching alone produced many false positives on short/common name-suffixes like -dasaru/-dasa and was not trusted on its own).

needs_human_review.why_unsure: 'Guru Jagannatha Dasaru' could be the same person as 'Jagannatha Dasaru' with an honorific prefix, or a distinct disciple/namesake — the Haridasa parampara reuses ankita names across generations.

Shares the 'Prasanna' lineage prefix but the ankita (Srinivasa vs Venkata) differs — likely a DIFFERENT dasa in the same guru-parampara, not the same person. Automated matching scored this as a probable duplicate; a Kannada reader should confirm before treating it as one.
'Venugopala' vs 'Gopala' — likely a different dasa, name-root match only.
'Rajagopala' vs 'Gopala' — likely a different dasa, name-root match only.
'Gopalaryaru' (Arya suffix) vs 'Gopala Dasaru/Dasa' (Dasa suffix) — different honorific tradition, probably not the same person.

web_side_likely_junk._note: These 34 web 'composer' files include several that are almost certainly scraper artifacts, not real composer identities — worth cleaning up regardless of this merge.

untitled_json.note: These are web-crawled compositions the scraper could not attribute to a composer. 370 of them DO have verse text — that's a real merge opportunity: fingerprint-match their Kannada text against dasa1's 13540 attributed keerthanas to recover a composer name for a chunk of these. The remaining 83 have no text at all and are likely dead/failed fetches (candidates for deletion, not merge).

app_composers_new_to_corpus._note: The remaining ~117 of 135 app dasaru (roughly 4800+ keerthanas) have no plausible match at all in the 34 web composer files — they are entirely new to the corpus. Top examples by volume: ಕಾಖಂಡಕಿ ಶ್ರೀ ಕೃಷ್ಣದಾಸರು (752), ರಾಮದಾಸರು (696), ಗುರುಗೋವಿಂದವಿಠಲರು (691), ಕಾಖಂಡಕಿ ಶ್ರೀ ಮಹಿಪತಿರಾಯರು (641), ತುಪಾಕಿ ವೆಂಕಟರಮಣಾಚಾರ್ಯ (491), ಅಸೂರಿ ರಾಮಸ್ವಾಮಿಅಯ್ಯಂಗಾರ್ (468), ಚಿದಾನಂದ ಅವಧೂತರು (426). Full list: dge/data/dasa_sahitya_local/dasa1/index.json -> counts_by_dasaru.

headline: The Android-app asset is a much larger and more broadly-attributed source than the web crawl: 135 dasaru / 13540 keerthanas here vs 34 composers / 1396 compositions there, with only ~11-16 composers confidently overlapping.
